name: enzgfm_native_same_support_catalyst_v1
objective: Train Catalyst only on the ReactZyme author train_val split, select between two predeclared candidates using a deterministic protein-disjoint internal development support, then retrain only the selected candidate on all retained author train_val pairs and reveal the native ReactZyme enzyme-similarity test exactly once.

authoritative_external_baseline.name: EnzGFM-1.5B
authoritative_external_baseline.task: bidirectional enzyme-reaction retrieval on the native ReactZyme enzyme-similarity split
authoritative_external_baseline.paper: An enzyme-specific protein language model for catalytic property prediction, Nature Communications 2026
authoritative_external_baseline.ndcg_reason: The paper reports NDCG but the exact K is not unambiguous in the accessible prose; retain our NDCG@10 as a metric but do not invent a direct paper delta.
authoritative_external_baseline.local_execution_boundary: Official EnzGFM-1.5B encoder assets are published, but the trained retrieval-head checkpoint/full downstream training recipe is not; paper values remain the unique authoritative external baseline. Local Catalyst candidates are not relabeled as an EnzGFM reproduction.

input_representation.reaction: 4096d Morgan radius2 fp2048 mean+max over canonicalized native unordered molecule bag; wildcard * replaced by C to match author get_samples semantics
input_representation.protein: 2048d externally pretrained EnzGFM-650M mean hidden representation, exact sequence lookup only
input_representation.claim_boundary: The 650M encoder is an input backbone/foundation representation, not the authoritative external retrieval baseline.

mapping_policy.test_sequence_support: must be 8734/8734 exact sequence mapped; otherwise abort before scores
mapping_policy.train_missing_policy: drop only exact-sequence-unmapped rows as input incompatibility and report count; no performance filtering
mapping_policy.duplicate_sequence_mapping: choose smallest aligned global feature row deterministically
mapping_policy.reaction_order: sorted normalized dot-separated molecule tokens; no outcome-based support filtering

internal_development.split: protein-disjoint hash split from author train_val only
internal_development.support_selection: lowest deterministic SHA256 priority by input identity only; no score/label-performance filtering except dropping query rows with no positive after fixed support intersection

dual_tower.architecture: LayerNorm-input -> Linear512 -> GELU -> Dropout0.1 -> Linear256 -> L2, separately for reaction/protein

author_pairwise.architecture: Official EnzGFM/ReactZyme PretrainedNetwork topology with only reaction/protein input dimensions adapted to 4096/2048; hidden128, nhead8, 4 encoder + 4 decoder Transformer layers, dropout0
author_pairwise.loss: BCEWithLogits with one deterministic train-only protein-negative and one reaction-negative per positive per epoch, rejecting known train positives

selection_rule.primary: harmonic mean of standard E2R MAP and R2E MAP on fixed internal dev support
tie_breakers: fixed candidate order dual_tower then author_pairwise

final_reveal.retrain: selected exact candidate on all retained author train_val pairs with unchanged recipe
